visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy dark hair, wearing a white sheer cardigan over a floral blue dress, stands in a tropical-style indoor cafe. She holds a coconut husk bowl filled with colorful ice cream and toppings, smiling brightly at the camera. The background features bamboo light fixtures and an arched mirror. (2) A close-up shot of a green menu board displays six different coconut ice cream options with pictures and prices in pesos. A staff member in a green shirt is partially visible behind the counter. (3) A sequence shows the preparation of the dessert. A person in a grey apron and green shirt uses a metal scoop to place four balls of white ice cream into a coconut shell resting on a digital scale. They then add a spoonful of purple rice and chunks of yellow mango. (4) The woman is sitting outdoors in a sunny area near a palm tree, eating the coconut ice cream with a wooden spoon. She takes a bite and expresses her enjoyment with wide eyes and a nod. (5) The scene shifts back to the cafe where the woman, now in just the blue dress, continues to eat. (6) A transition to a new location shows a purple storefront with a large sign reading "ube mama". A menu on the door describes purple yam desserts. (7) Inside the purple-themed shop, a staff member in a purple uniform prepares a new dessert. They add scoops of purple yam and cornflakes into a bowl. (8) A metal extrusion machine is used to squeeze thin strands of purple yam paste over the dessert, creating a noodle-like appearance. (9) The woman holds the ube dessert in front of the store and takes a large bite, reacting to the flavor with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
